i.norm: Verifies that {@link Base16} rejects characters that are not part of the Base16 alphabet.

Each of these characters sits just outside the valid Base16 ranges ('0'-'9', 'A'-'F', 'a'-'f'), so decoding any of them must fail:
  • '/' (0x2F) is just before '0'
  • ':' (0x3A) is just after '9'
  • '@' (0x40) is just before 'A'
  • 'G' (0x47) is just after 'F'
  • '%' (0x25) is well below the digit range
  • '`' (0x60) is just before 'a'
  • 'g' (0x67) is just after 'f'
